label: Cursor
notes: Reads AGENTS.md and .cursor/skills (command name = folder name). The Forge also emits an always-applied .cursor/rules/resonance.mdc that points at AGENTS.md and loads the .resonance project memory, so the carrier holds even where AGENTS.md auto-load is unreliable. Model-agnostic (user picks the backing model), so default overlay is claude but cursor users on GPT/Gemini should build with --model accordingly.
